clips.send: Motif. A tiny musical idea you can recognize. Often just 2–6 notes. Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony is built from a four-note motif: short-short-short-LONG.
clips.text: Motif. A tiny musical idea you can recognize. Often just 2–6 notes. Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony is built from a four-note motif: short-short-short-LONG.

clips.send: Dont mix up: The melody and the chords are different layers — the melody sits on top.
clips.text: Dont mix up: The melody and the chords are different layers — the melody sits on top.

clips.send: Dont mix up: A cadence is about chords at the END of a phrase, not the speed (that’s tempo).
clips.text: Dont mix up: A cadence is about chords at the END of a phrase, not the speed (that’s tempo).

clips.send: Dont mix up: A motif is shorter than a phrase or a theme.
clips.text: Dont mix up: A motif is shorter than a phrase or a theme.

clips.send: Dont mix up: Not every phrase ends “home”: the first often ends on a question (half cadence).
clips.text: Dont mix up: Not every phrase ends “home”: the first often ends on a question (half cadence).

clips.send: Cadence. Musical punctuation. V, I equals full stop, ends on V equals question mark. Film composers use deceptive cadences (V, vi) to surprise you.
clips.text: Cadence. Musical punctuation. V→I = full stop, ends on V = question mark. Film composers use deceptive cadences (V→vi) to surprise you.

clips.send: Phrase. A musical sentence. Usually 2 or 4 bars long — about one breath of singing. Phrases end with a cadence, like sentences end with punctuation.
clips.text: Phrase. A musical sentence. Usually 2 or 4 bars long — about one breath of singing. Phrases end with a cadence, like sentences end with punctuation.

clips.send: Chord and progression. Notes stacked together, then moving in order. A triad stacks 1-3-5 of a scale step. A progression is the order of chords — the song’s “road map.”
clips.text: Chord & progression. Notes stacked together, then moving in order. A triad stacks 1-3-5 of a scale step. A progression is the order of chords — the song’s “road map.”

clips.send: Dont mix up: 起承转合 is about the shape of phrases, not a set of chords.
clips.text: Dont mix up: 起承转合 is about the shape of phrases, not a set of chords.

clips.send: Form: AB, ABA, verse–chorus. The big shape of a piece. A equals one section, B equals a contrasting section. ABA returns to the start — like a sandwich. Pop songs alternate verse and chorus.
clips.text: Form: AB, ABA, verse–chorus. The big shape of a piece. A = one section, B = a contrasting section. ABA returns to the start — like a sandwich. Pop songs alternate verse and chorus.

clips.send: Dont mix up: Repetition is not lazy: listeners love coming back to the chorus.
clips.text: Dont mix up: Repetition is not lazy: listeners love coming back to the chorus.

clips.send: 起承转合 qǐ chéng zhuǎn hé. The Chinese four-phrase plan. 起 begin – 承 continue – 转 turn – 合 close. Phrase 2 echoes phrase 1, phrase 3 changes direction, phrase 4 brings it home. Many Chinese folk songs and poems follow it.
clips.text: 起承转合 qǐ chéng zhuǎn hé. The Chinese four-phrase plan. 起 begin – 承 continue – 转 turn – 合 close. Phrase 2 echoes phrase 1, phrase 3 changes direction, phrase 4 brings it home. Many Chinese folk songs and poems follow it.

clips.send: 易错点：旋律和和弦是两层——旋律在最上面。
clips.text: 易错点：旋律和和弦是两层——旋律在最上面。

clips.send: 和弦与和弦进行。叠在一起的音，按顺序前进。三和弦由某一级音的 1-3-5 叠成。 和弦进行就是和弦的顺序——歌曲的“路线图”。
clips.text: 和弦与和弦进行. 叠在一起的音，按顺序前进. 三和弦由某一级音的 1-3-5 叠成。 和弦进行就是和弦的顺序——歌曲的“路线图”。

clips.send: 终止。音乐的标点符号。V，I 等于 句号，停在 V 等于 问号。 电影配乐常用阻碍终止（V，vi）制造意外。
clips.text: 终止. 音乐的标点符号. V→I = 句号，停在 V = 问号。 电影配乐常用阻碍终止（V→vi）制造意外。

clips.send: 易错点：终止说的是乐句末尾的和弦，不是速度。
clips.text: 易错点：终止说的是乐句末尾的和弦，不是速度。

clips.send: 曲式：AB、ABA、主歌、副歌。整首曲子的大结构。A 等于 一个段落，B 等于 对比的段落。 ABA 会回到开头——像三明治。流行歌曲是主歌、副歌交替。
clips.text: 曲式：AB、ABA、主歌—副歌. 整首曲子的大结构. A = 一个段落，B = 对比的段落。 ABA 会回到开头——像三明治。流行歌曲是主歌、副歌交替。

clips.send: 易错点：动机比乐句、主题都短。
clips.text: 易错点：动机比乐句、主题都短。

clips.send: 乐句。音乐的“句子”。通常 2 或 4 小节——大约唱一口气。 乐句以终止结束，就像句子以标点结束。
clips.text: 乐句. 音乐的“句子”. 通常 2 或 4 小节——大约唱一口气。 乐句以终止结束，就像句子以标点结束。

clips.send: 动机。一个能被认出来的小乐思。常常只有 2—6 个音。 贝多芬《第五交响曲》就是从四个音的动机“短短短长”发展出来的。

clips.send: 易错点：并不是每个乐句都回到家：第一句常常停在问号（半终止）上。
clips.text: 易错点：并不是每个乐句都回到家：第一句常常停在问号（半终止）上。

clips.send: 易错点：重复不是偷懒：听众最爱副歌再次出现。
clips.text: 易错点：重复不是偷懒：听众最爱副歌再次出现。

clips.send: 易错点：起承转合讲的是乐句的布局，不是和弦。
clips.text: 易错点：起承转合讲的是乐句的布局，不是和弦。

clips.send: 起承转合。中国传统的四句结构。起——开头；承——承接；转——转折；合——收束。 第二句承接第一句，第三句换个方向，第四句回到主音。许多中国民歌和诗歌都是这样。
